titleEn: Ebda Chat assistant (how-do-I answers and doing tasks)
screens: AssistantPanel (side panel on every screen, Ctrl/Cmd+J)

en: Ask the assistant how to do something
Let the assistant do it for me

steps: Open the assistant panel (button or Ctrl/Cmd+J), ask how to do something, follow the "show me where" link
The assistant answers only from the help guides and from your own data it reads through the normal screens; it never asks for passwords or keys
Off by default per store; an operator turns it on (answer-only) and can switch it off at once
edgeCases: Mode off: the panel is hidden and the route answers status off
Over 150 turns per store per day: the reply says the limit was reached
The help index has no confirmed answer: it says so and offers the support team

readOnlyPost.reason: A turn answers questions, reads the merchant's own data and builds previews; it applies nothing (the apply and undo routes are the assistant.apply-changes capability). The only thing a turn writes is the assistant's own masked journal row.
